review_comments:
I think that we have a general anti-pattern here: we should just say "Could not parse %s.%s …", section, lvalue". This is both easier for us (because we don't have to craft a custom error message), *and* easier for the user, because they don't have to try to guess what setting we were trying to describe.

I think we should rework most error messages like this. But we should probably do that in one big pull request. So let's merge this, since it fixes other issues too.
I agree. I will do that later.
